- Location verbatim: *"London"* | Years: *"3+ years in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant, or similar client-facing role at a SaaS company"* | Language: none specified | Salary: not disclosed
- https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/released/jobs/7685744003
- Fit: lists the exact three role types he is targeting, at exactly his experience level.
- Form: CV + optional cover letter, education level, work-eligibility confirmation, "where did you first hear about this".

**13. Zeotap | Implementation Engineer UK** — SPONSORSHIP NEEDED
- Location verbatim: *"London, United Kingdom"* with Remote available within the UK | Years: **none stated** | Language: *"You speak English fluently"* | Salary: not disclosed | *"Full Time"*
- https://jobs.lever.co/zeotap/836be090-971f-487a-ac77-1fb6260b49e7
- Fit: no years bar at all, which is rare — and CDP implementation is API-integration work he can genuinely do.

## Notable kills (verified and dropped)

- **Years/level gate:** Nearform Italy FDE (8 yrs — the one Italy-based FDE found), GitLab (Staff), Nebuly (5+), Runlayer (5+ and CS degree), Outset EU (5+), Kota (5+), Cresta (5+), PlanetScale (5+), DoiT (5+), OpenAI Munich (7+), Turgon (7+), Soji AI Hamburg (8+), Aera (7+), Lifted (8+).
- **Language gate:** VOIDS Hamburg (fluent German required), Happyrobot (German-speaking), Talkdesk (bilingual German), Quantum Metric UK (Italian-speaking), Algolia (German speaker).
- **Wrong continent:** Aircall (New York), Cruva (LA), Mesh (US), Tailscale (Canada), Agiloft (Canada), Coworked (US), Canals AI (Americas), Global Talent Co (LatAm), Sprinto (India), Algolia (Seattle).

- **NEEDS_BROWSER, insufficient signal to return:** Mercura, Dash0, Jellyfish, Matia, Glia (its Implementation Engineer no longer appears on the company job list — probably closed), Riot Security, ITRS, Graph.one.

Two structural notes: the sweep is UK-heavy at the top end because continental-EU FDE/SE roles overwhelmingly gate on German, and almost every remaining "Europe remote" FDE role sits at 5+ years. Novosafe, Arize and Spyrosoft are the three worth prioritising — they are the only ones where the stated experience bar, the language requirement and his work authorisation all line up without a caveat.
